seeds.why: Pre-#1265 check_time_monotonic: no SET timezone clause, so the time column is cast to timestamptz in the caller's session zone, and a naive wall time inside that zone's spring-forward gap reads an hour late: a column rising across New York's gap reports 0.5 from America/New_York and 1.0 from UTC, and a pair that falls across it reads as rising. One site, the clause. tests/335 parts A, B and C catch it.
